tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'dod rgyal rjes gnang // 'o nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan snyam pas byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi zab chos dbang sdud kyi mthar thug khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i 'dod pa lha dang gsang sngags sgra'i rjes su gnang ba gnyis las/ 'dir 'dod pa lha yi rjes su gnang ba zab mo sgrub par byed pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub nas/ da khyed rang rnams kyi sku skal du gyur pa la rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs nas maṇḍal zhig dbul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ rdo rje rnal 'byor dbang phyug gtso/ /gsang ba'i cho ga bla na med/ /dbang du byed pa'i rig sngags mchog /bdag la nges par stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum/ rgyud dag pa'i ched du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'dod pa'i rgyal po la skyabs gnas dam pa thams cad kyis bskor ba'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams 'khod nas yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs de ltar rgyud dag par byas nas rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa'i phyir slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis khyed rang rnams kyi sdig sgrib dang gdos bcas kyi lus sbyangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dmar po 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i zhes pa nas/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes nas/ zhu ba las bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ khyed rang rnams khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po nas/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol nas/ dbu brgyan bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo nas zhu nas bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag sogs sgrub thabs bzhin/ khyed rang rnams 'dod rgyal yab yum du gsal ba'i yab kyi thugs kar hūm̐ yig dmar po slob dpon gyi thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ yig dmar po sngags phreng gis bskor bar dmigs nas bzlas lung zab mo zhu ba'i yon du tsandan dmar pos byugs pa'i maṇḍal la me tog dmar pos maṇḍal phul ba'i mos pa mdzod la/ maṇḍal zhig dbul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /dmigs med thugs rje las 'khrungs pa'i/ /'phrin las dngos grub 'byung ba'i phyir/ /'dir ni rjes su gnang bar mdzod/ /de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis spro'am dri ba ni/ 'gro ba sems can don slad du/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /dmigs med thugs rje las byung ba'i/ /thabs kyi phrin las zab mo'i don/ /bden zhing bsdu bar mi 'gyur ba'i/ /gsang ched 'di la khyod dad dam/ /zhes dris pas lan btab par mos pa mdzod nas/ 'di'i rjes zlos lan gcig mdzod/ 'gro ba sogs gong bzhin la/ gsang chen 'di la bdag dad do/ /zhes lan btab nas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas sngags phreng byung / zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzad nas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ oṃ wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ nas/ bha na te mā ra ṇaṃ/ 'gro ba mang po wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ bar tshar gsum/ de ltar bzlas pa de nyid brtan pa'i phyir/ slob dpon gyis khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor me tog bzhag nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/

bdag la ji ltar yod pa bzhin/ /'di la bgo bar mdzad du gsol/ /de nas slob dpon gyis gtor ma khyed rang rnams kyi mgo thog tu bzhag nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ zhes gtor ma slob ma re re bzhin gyi mgo bor bzhag la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /zhi ba'i phrin las chen po yis/ /nad dang gnod pa zhi bar mdzod/ /tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par gyis/ /gdul bya dbang du 'du bar gyis/ /bstan la gnod pa gsad par gyis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /byin gyis brlabs kyi khro bo ni/ /dbang bskur pho nya'i las mdzad pa/ /khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po yi/ /'di yi bsgrub bya 'grub par gyis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gdul bya sems can 'dul ba'i phyir/ /mkha' 'gro'i gzugs su snang mdzad de/ /dam tshig sdong grogs mdzad gyur pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi/ /'di yi bsgrub bya 'grub par gyis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /'gro ba sems can gdul bya'i phyir/ /dmigs med thugs rje las byung ba'i/ /thabs kyi phrin las zab mo'i don/ /bden zhing bslu bar mi 'gyur ba'i/ /gsang chen 'di ni bsgrub par gyis/ /thams cad la tshar ba dang / gtor ma sngar shul du bzhag la/ de nas dam tshig bsgo ba 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ 'di ni mchog tu ngo mtshar che/ /phrin las snying po khyad par can/ /gsang ba las kyang ches gsang nas/ /sgrub la 'bad na 'grub 'gyur bas/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya zhing / /spel na dngos grub nyams par 'gyur/ /des na khyed kyis nam yang ni/ /spel zhing bsgrag par mi bya zhing / /snod ldan gcig la nub mi bya/ /tshogs kyi mchod pas mnyes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas de lta bu'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du gzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ gtso bos sogs spyi 'gre yin no/

/zhes 'di ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ /'dod rgyal rjes gnang gong ma'i gsung mchan gyi/ /gsal byed sa skya kun blos gong dkar du/ /rang gi cho mos 'dus par spel phyir sbyar// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ 'dod rgyal rjes gnang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
